context_facts.name: compatibility_notes
context_facts.value: This page lists the specific configurations for which the server vendor has submitted certification test results to VMware, including BIOS version. These are not the only supported or recommended configurations. Best practice is generally to use the latest BIOS version available for the server, even if it is newer than listed here. For further details about BIOS, server product configurations, and best practices, please contact the server vendor. Modern CPUs are capable of supporting SMP-FT. To check the capability of a specific CPU, visit https://compatibilityguide.broadcom.com/search?program=cpu&persona=live. vSphere 8.0 certified servers can support SMP-FT. Refer to VMware Docs for Fault Tolerance requirements, limits, and licensing. CPU Notes: Boot from SD/USB flash media is not supported. ESXi 7.0u3 support starts at ESXi 7.0 Update 3i. For build information see https://kb.vmware.com/s/article/2143832 For support of 'Zen 4c' or AMD 3D V-Cache™ technology, contact your hardware vendor for the minimum BIOS/UEFI firmware version required.

limitations: Statements describe their own source record, not the configuration or condition of an auction unit.
Seller statements remain seller claims; photographed firmware is an observation of that unit.
Historical compatibility and source-code/document indexes do not establish bootability, download access, current support or license entitlement.

Not collected means no statements from the reviewed fact-name mapping; inspect unclassified facts and source captures. It does not mean evidence is absent from all collected fields or that the unit cannot operate. No suffix decoding or family fallback is used.
A collected category is not a complete buying assessment or readiness check.
